faq.q1: How do I hear about my child?
faq.a1: You get a notification for every boarding and alighting. Keep notifications on.
faq.a2: If a trip ends while your child is still on board, you get an immediate alert and the driver and school follow it until your child is confirmed safe.
faq.q3: Why don't notifications reach my iPhone?
faq.a3: On iPhone: Share → "Add to Home Screen". Or install the Tammeni app.
